name: Right Thigh — Red Light Wing
body: Heat made habitable. Six couples coded for nightlife, performance, sacred sexuality, or the particular brand of shameless expertise that turns desire into art. The air runs warmer here than anywhere else in the house — studio lights, Morrighan's ambient inferno, and the simple thermodynamic reality of this many sluts in one hallway. Morrighan and Vesper anchor it as thigh leads: the Succubus Queen and the Twilight Blade, fire and dusk, ink and bass.
